status: frozen BEFORE any v3 generation, scoring, or family code execution
purpose: Confirmatory closure attempt for the Phase-I six-condition oracle: calibrated 1%-FPR thresholds on >=299 independent negatives, four scored consumers, third watermark family, Tree-Ring ring-variant control, ICC/gamma decision-level axis, EXIF axis replication.

riva_gan.embedding: imwatermark RivaGAN ONNX (pinned venv), 32 bits, key seeds derive_seed('pilot_v3_key',20281001,idx)
riva_gan.unmarked_fpr: negative indices 400..699 (300 fresh SD2.1-base generations, seeds derive_seed('pilot_v3_neg',20281001,j), prompts PROMPTS[j mod 64])

tree_ring_rand.embedding: WIBE Tree-Ring, 32x32 latent, radius 5, mask circle, pattern 'rand' (same as v2, replication)
tree_ring_rand.unmarked_fpr: negative indices 700..999 (300 fresh, disjoint from riva_gan negatives)

tree_ring_ring.embedding: WIBE Tree-Ring, pattern 'ring' (radius 5, 32x32 latent) — NEW control variant, tests whether ring variant survives rotation

dwt_dct_svd.embedding: imwatermark dwtDctSvd (32 bits) — third family, classical

carriers.marked: fresh SD2.1-base 256x256 generations seeded derive_seed('pilot_v3_gen',20281001,idx) with prompt PROMPTS[idx mod 64]; RivaGAN/dwtDctSvd marked = clean carriers watermarked post-hoc; Tree-Ring marked = generator-native (latents injected)
carriers.unmarked: fresh SD2.1-base generations from the SAME generator pipeline but WITHOUT watermark injection (RivaGAN/dwt families) or latent injection (Tree-Ring); never previously scored in any pilot

independence: All v3 lineages (200..247 marked, 300..323 cal-negatives, 400..1599 FPR negatives) are disjoint from every v1/v2 index and from each other. v1 used 32..63; v2 used 0..63 carriers and 6..17 negatives; color_axis used 46..48.
threshold_rule: Primary: minimum eligible adjacent-unique-score midpoint with zero empirical calibration-FPR, strict >, fitted on the 6 marked_cal + 6 unmarked_cal + 6 wrong_key_cal scores ONLY. PREDECLARED SENSITIVITY: also persist maximum eligible midpoint threshold and BOTH min-rule and max-rule decisions for every eval/FPR row, so the forking-path disclosed in post_v2_audit.md cannot recur silently. If no eligible midpoint exists persist null and mark family uncalibrated. This rule is an empirical zero-FP operating point, not a validated 1% FPR.
fpr_calibration: Score all 300 independent unmarked FPR negatives per family at the fitted primary threshold. 1%-FPR gate: upper one-sided exact 95% binomial bound on FPR must be <= 1.5% (with 0 false accepts in 300, the bound is 0.9967% <= 1.5% PASS; any false accept >= 1 makes the bound >= 1.21% and fails unless <= 2 accepts total... see gate field). Also record raw empirical FPR.
fpr_gate: PASS iff false_accepts == 0 in 300 (95% upper bound 0.9967% < 1%). Any false accept -> FAIL, report the count; do not shift threshold post hoc.

scored: harness pillow_raw (Image.open().convert('RGB') — EXIF-ignoring; harness-chosen policy, disclosed)
imagemagick_default (identify/convert to PNG via subprocess, then decoded) — fourth scored consumer
consumers.browser: pinned Chromium 151.0.7922.34 canvas + UI element screenshot for EXIF and ICC fixtures (evidence consumer, not scored)

axes.exif: orientation=6 JPEG quality 95 4:4:4, same-byte verifier/display split, baked-visible and ordinary-JPEG controls, SSIM >= 0.90 admission (preregistered), identity rows
axes.icc_gamma: NEW decision-level axis: for each marked_eval image per family, produce (a) plain PNG, (b) iCCP A98 RGB PNG, (c) gAMA 0.8 PNG, (d) baked-ICC control. Score (a)-(d) under pillow_raw and pillow_managed (ImageCms) consumers. Consumer decision differential = same file bytes, different consumer decision. This is the non-alpha ICC/gamma route attempt.

admission: SSIM(display, rotated_source) >= 0.90 for EXIF rows; ICC/gamma rows admitted iff SSIM(decoded_metadata, plain) >= 0.90 under the managed consumer.
repeat: Fresh model-load exact score/tensor repeat for >= 1 eval event per family; output persisted to results/repeat_scores.log.
evaluation: Primary events per family: (1) identity accept 6/6; (2) EXIF same-byte raw-accept AND display-reject on >= 1 of 6 eval EXIF rows; (3) 0 false accepts on 300 FPR negatives; (4) 0 wrong-key eval accepts; (5) ICC/gamma consumer-decision differential on >= 1 row; (6) all four scored consumers recorded for every scored row. Across-family EXIF claim requires primary events (1),(2),(3) in both post-hoc families or in tree_ring_ring if the rand result is variant-limited.
six_condition_oracle_mapping: same-byte=C2 EXIF/ICC rows; decision-differential=C2/C5; calibrated FPR=C3 (300-neg gate); four consumers=C4; third family=dwt_dct_svd inclusion; deployed=NOT in v3 (loopback only remains).
budget: GPU wall-clock cap 5400 s total; CPU families (RivaGAN/dwtDctSvd embedding) negligible. Tree-Ring families: ~2 s/gen marked, ~6-8 s/negative inversion+score — 4 families x (12 marked + 300 neg) tree-ring loads ~75 min for two tree-ring families combined; acceptable under cap.
deviations: Any deviation from this protocol must be recorded in pilot_v3/DEVIATIONS.md BEFORE continuing execution, with the reason and the affected rows.
attestation: This file is frozen by writing it once, hashing it (sha256 recorded in results/verification.json before any eval score), and refusing overwrite in all v3 scripts. Local mtime attestation only; no external registration exists.
